name: @deepviewer/desktop
description: DeepViewer desktop shell for DeepSeek Harness

scripts.build: vite build --config vite.main.config.ts && vite build --config vite.preload.config.ts && vite build --config vite.renderer.config.ts
scripts.package: pnpm build && pnpm runtime && node scripts/package.mjs
scripts.package:arm64: pnpm build && pnpm runtime:arm64 && node scripts/package.mjs --arch=arm64
scripts.package:x64: pnpm build && pnpm runtime:x64 && node scripts/package.mjs --arch=x64
